stage1_evidence_shown.label: PURPOSE
stage1_evidence_shown.context: The aetiology of osteochondritis dissecans is still unclear. The aim of this prospective pilot study was to analyse whether vitamin D insufficiency, or deficiency, might be a contributing etiological factor in the development of an OCD lesion.

stage1_evidence_shown.label: METHODS
stage1_evidence_shown.context: The serum level of vitamin D3 in 23 consecutive patients (12 male and 11 female) suffering from a stage III, or stages III and IV, OCD lesion (mostly stage III) admitted for surgery was measured.

stage2_added_evidence.context: The patients' mean age was 31.3 years and most of them already exhibited closed epiphyseal plates. stage2_full_context_shown.context: The serum level of vitamin D3 in 23 consecutive patients (12 male and 11 female) suffering from a stage III, or stages III and IV, OCD lesion (mostly stage III) admitted for surgery was measured.
